label.zh: 尸检与无人机：两项都要做
label.en: Autopsy and drone: both must be done

note.zh: 洞穴路线上，“鸟类解剖”（2625，设置标记 avian_autopsy）与“无人机修复”（2630，设置标记 drone_reactivated）可按任意顺序，各自的第一个选项指向另一个；只有两个标记都已设置，才会出现通向 2640 的选项。
note.en: On the cave route the “Avian Autopsy” (2625, sets flag avian_autopsy) and “Drone Repaired” (2630, sets flag drone_reactivated) can be done in either order, the first option of each leading to the other; the option to 2640 only appears once both flags are set.

label.en: What to do with the lab

note.zh: 仅限有机物种且非荒野帝国可选“记录并研究”（→ 2650）；机械物种只有“很迷人”（→ 2655）；有机物种另可“关闭设施”（→ 2655）。
note.en: Only an organic species in a non-Wilderness empire may “Document and study” (→ 2650); a non-organic species only gets “Fascinating” (→ 2655); an organic species may also “Shut down the Facility” (→ 2655).

label.zh: 自动清洁：记录基础设施

note.zh: 大量星界丝缕；格式塔帝国另得社会研究；设置国家标记 edict_automated_disinfection；探索结束。
note.en: Large astral thread reward; gestalt empires also get society research; sets country flag edict_automated_disinfection; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 能量收入（不友善帝国为更高档），加大量星界丝缕；探索结束。
note.en: An energy income (a higher tier for unfriendly empires) plus a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 瘫痪无人机后撤退：合金收入与大量星界丝缕；探索结束。
note.en: Retreating after disabling the drones: an alloy income and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 标本“改造的清洁无人机”；大量星界丝缕与殖民无人机修正（荒野帝国为荒野版）；探索结束。
note.en: Specimen “repurposed cleaning drone”; a large astral thread reward and the colonization-drones modifier (Wilderness variant for Wilderness empires); the exploration ends.

note.zh: 大量星界丝缕，并按尚未持有的加密/解密科技赠送一项，否则一项计算类研究选项；探索结束。
note.en: A large astral thread reward plus the first encryption/decryption technology not yet owned, else a computing research option; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 大量星界丝缕；科学家获得特质 leader_trait_sanitary_drone；探索结束。
note.en: A large astral thread reward; the scientist gains trait leader_trait_sanitary_drone; the exploration ends.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1，无条件；不产出遗珍，没有失败分支。
notes.en: Draw weight 1, no conditions; no relic and no failure branch (00_astral_rifts.txt:344-353).

notes.zh: 2665 的“殖民无人机”修正会让新殖民事件 astral_rift.2698（on_colonization_started，00_on_actions.txt:1279）随机给新殖民星球添加阻挡物；它是后续的副作用而不是本故事的一章，未并入。
notes.en: The colonization-drones modifier of 2665 makes the hidden colonization event astral_rift.2698 (on_colonization_started, 00_on_actions.txt:1279) randomly add blockers to new colonies; it is a side effect, not a chapter of this story, and is not merged.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 2600–2675 全部事件、选项条件、标记（clean_shot / avian_autopsy / drone_reactivated）及奖励。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 2600–2675 with option conditions, flags (clean_shot / avian_autopsy / drone_reactivated) and rewards.
